scope: 華醫F圖書館與F1–F4系館連體群同一既有模型之東截錐瓦帽歷史限域配色；不增套數、不納G、不聲稱完整2026復原。

date_evidence.verification: Reviewer read the exact photo-stats-models record in saved flickr.html; camera clock and true capture event not independently verified. Wide photograph individual date not newly verified; official gate capture date unknown.
date_evidence.not_current_condition: 2024 seismic-retrofit planning is retained in history; post-retrofit completion/recoloring not obtained, so 2026 condition is not asserted.

per_view_review.observations: Only east-facing truncated-cone slope is red-brown. Circular flat top, shoulder walls, curved window recesses and other roofs are neutral. Full model/base uncropped.
West cap slope and rear group remain neutral. A small visible red edge belongs to east-facing geometry, not red leakage onto the rear slope.
East cap uniformly red-brown within existing sloping facets; blank top and side shoulders not painted. Five original curved glass recesses remain neutral rather than claiming pure glass.
East-half cutoff follows the conservative x>=34 extent; this is an evidence boundary, not a claimed real tile/color seam. No paint on adjoining shoulder or south roof.
Half annular slope red-brown, central top disk and west half neutral. Color stops exactly at half-cap boundary; no colored roof infill, textures or changed geometry.

independent_method: Reviewer script imports no builder classifier: parses binary STL/3MF and exact ordered triangles; creates 72 actual 3D trapezoid facets from analytic top/bottom vertices, tests all three triangle vertices on one sloping plane and inside all four finite edges, plus x>=34 and height64..68.5, outward winding. No centroid, triangle splitting or radial-only selection. 76 selected indices exactly match final material map; 5026 remain neutral.
material_scope: Only original east slope, center(34,-49), bottom r13/top r9/h4.5. Caps, bottom, west half, white shoulders, all other roofs, five glass-band recesses, column mixed bands and walls excluded.
disclosures: Red-brown #925A4E is uncalibrated opaque historical color proxy, not measured tile or structural material. No photo texture or invented tile geometry.
East/west half-color cutoff is a conservative evidence limit, not a naturally observed color seam. Neutral means unresolved, not actual gray paint.
Original truncated-cone proportions, building-group massing and concealed/rear simplifications inherited; limited coloring does not repair or newly certify whole-building geometry.
Original STL and 5102 triangle order/coordinates unchanged; 2549 indexed vertices. 3MF is a surface-color mesh, not separate watertight colored parts or slicer/toolhead mapping.

Historical manufacturing QA was read/preserved rather than rerun. No physical printing, GUI slicing, multicolor route, exhaustive wall thickness or support-removal test; no printability or support-free guarantee.

scene-validation: geometry/material stored correctly and material edit/save/reopen; Blend hash bound.
